name: TGI batch-concatenation counter by reason
notes: TGI main, router/src/server.rs plus backends/v3/src/{backend,queue,lib}.rs, read 2026-10-04. On by default: the Prometheus recorder is built unconditionally with PrometheusBuilder and an HTTP listener on prometheus_port, default 9000, so nothing has to be opted into. Label keys are method (prefill|decode) on the batch families, err on tgi_request_failure, and reason on tgi_batch_concat - there are no model or engine labels, so every series is fleet-wide.  reason in {backpressure, chunking, wait_exceeded}. These are the three ways TGI admits less work than it could, which is the observable trace of an overloaded system.
